security_controls.evidence: AdapterContractMatrix rejects manifest capabilities containing exact credential keys and common env/token/cache/session patterns including OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, auth_token, bearer_token, cookie_file, session_path, provider_cache_path, token-like keys, and provider cache/session path values.
local_subscription_cli execution mode is valid only when credential_mode is local_subscription; no token, session, cache, or subscription state is stored.
ProviderOrchestrationPolicy.prepare_execution returns manual_required with provider_cli_unavailable and a manual_run_bundle instead of a success claim when the local CLI is unavailable.

ProviderOrchestrationPolicy.prepare_execution returns execution_blocked unless approved packet boundary, explicit local configuration, outside-repo authentication, command descriptor, timeout, cancel support, non-interactive capture, and current input snapshot are all represented.
Provider output is modeled as route/evidence/adjudication read-model data. AdapterBoundaryValidator negative tests reject direct state mutation events.

AdapterBoundaryValidator requires harness-trusted permission roots, validates artifact paths against those roots, rejects worker-supplied root expansion, rejects stale input snapshot mismatch, and rejects missing provenance, malformed envelopes, and mock success. AdapterInvocationLedger has a negative test proving omitted trusted roots cannot self-authorize ingestion.
Routing results expose provider labels and adapter ids as replaceable adapter attributes and always report product_identity false.

ProviderOrchestrationLedger validates output envelopes before persistence, records provider_orchestration.run_recorded and provider_orchestration.adjudication_recorded events, keeps truth_claim false, supports query by packet, role, adapter, provider, status, and adjudication state, and has replay coverage proving provider orchestration event types do not block recovery.

residual_risk: PKT-06 does not execute real Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI processes. Future packets that add command execution must repeat security review for command construction, process isolation, timeout/cancel behavior, and local provider terms.
